title: China names Pakistani astronaut for first foreign mission to space station
description:
China on Tuesday unveiled the crew for its Shenzhou 24 spacecraft ahead of this week's launch, with a Pakistani set to become the first foreign astronaut to board its space station.
According to official Chinese news agency Xinhua, the China Manned Space Agency announced that Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali will carry out the mission with his Chinese colleagues Tang Hongbo and Wu Yi. The agency said the spacecraft was scheduled to launch from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre in northwest China on Wednesday morning.
State broadcaster CCTV said the Pakistani astronaut would carry out a short-term mission as a payload specialist. During the in-orbit phase, he would primarily take care of experiments for the cooperation between China and Pakistan, in addition to daily operations.
His mission will be to carry out four scientific projects in the fields of biotechnology and materials, and he is set to conduct an in-orbit experiment on photosynthetic microorganisms, CCTV ...
